data.narrative:
Rangeview operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at the Seed stage, having raised $5M+. The comparable universe consists of one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics, though none provides sufficiently tight comparables for median peer valuation work.

Stage-progression analysis, the applicable method here, uses the $5M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $12M. The method rests on the assumption that capital raised correlates with post-Seed valuation step-ups in this sector, though founder equity stake and deployment efficiency remain unvalidated from available data.

The triangulated range is $11M to $14M, with a median of $12M, derived from a single method. Key uncertainties include: absence of a statistically meaningful private peer set (only one same-stage comparable identified), making sector-wide benchmarking unreliable; unknown burn rate and product-market traction relative to the raised capital; and limited visibility into founder dilution or reserve allocations. A pre-Series A valuation would benefit from revenue multiples, customer concentration, or technology differentiation metrics not present in this dataset.
